Compute 17*23 and reply with only the number.
Read cfg.json in the current directory and reply with only the value of service.port.

task: Count the number of lines of text in notes.txt and reply with only that number.
Sum all the integers in nums.txt and reply with only the total.
Read app.json and reply with only the value of server.db.port.
Combine the lines of a.txt and b.txt into a new file merged.txt, sorted alphabetically with duplicate lines removed (one word per line).

task: In greeting.txt, change every occurrence of the word world to graff, leaving everything else unchanged.

setup_files.greeting.txt:
hello world
goodbye world
keep this line

check.cmd: grep -q '^hello graff$' greeting.txt && grep -q '^goodbye graff$' greeting.txt && grep -q '^keep this line$' greeting.txt && ! grep -q world greeting.txt

task: Remove every line containing the word DROP from data.txt, leaving the remaining lines in their original order.

keep1

keep2
